items.description: DexSearch: all 1025 Pokémon as white silhouettes on red, the magnifier from its icon showing Garchomp in color

components.content:
## Offline Pokédex and team builder
Every Pokémon, form, move, ability and held item from Gen 1 to 9, with per-game Pokédexes and TMs, the type chart and Smogon sets. Build a team, see its type defenses and coverage, run the damage calc, copy it for Showdown.
-# English · Polski · Español · 日本語 · no account, no ads, works offline

**Android**
Install the APK once; updates arrive inside the app.

**iPhone and computers**
Open it in Safari or any browser, then add it to the home screen.
-# Free, unofficial fan project. Source on [GitHub](https://github.com/D3anDark/dexsearch).
